  <title>Africa Electrical Power Generating Stations (GIS Feature Class)</title>
  <abstract>This feature class contains the power-generating stations that were operational, in rehabilitation, or had idle capacity in Africa in 2018. Data for each facility were obtained from Cross-border Information (London) Ltd. and their African Energy Live Data platform (https://www.africa-energy.com/live-data). Power stations were categorized by the USGS into “Capacity Range” groups according to their installed capacity (in megawatts, if known) and “Fuel Categories” based on the type of fuel(s) consumed in the generation of electricity. Fuel categories include Renewable (solar, wind, hydro, biomass, and geothermal), Non-Renewable (diesel, fuel oils including crude and heavy fuel oil, and natural gas), Hybrid (a combination of renewable and non-renewable fuel types), and Other/Unknown for those where facility data is insufficient for categorization. In this feature class, the attribute field names have been modified from their original source to fit our GIS attributes table schema; descriptive field aliases were created from the original field names in the source data.*Note: There are several entries in the source database that lack geographical coordinate locations (Latitude and Longitude) but contain other data that are of value for this geodatabase (e.g. qualitative location, installed capacity, controlling authority, equity holders), which may be used to assess the energy capacity of different countries in the study area. As such, we have included those data in this geodatabase.

Power generation facilities in Africa stored as points in the feature class "AFR_Infra_Power_Stations" for use in a geographic information system (GIS). This dataset includes only facilities that were idle, in operation or in rehabilitation in 2018.</abstract>
